title: ÆTHER album Kaattu Thee, song 1: Introduction (hero entry, 1 min test)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: An explosive modern Tamil film mass hero-introduction song, new-generation Kollywood sound: punchy EDM and trap production fused with raw Tamil kuthu energy, parai and thappu drums, heavy 808 bass, a sharp synth lead and a whistle-like riff. Sung in Tamil with casual English swag words mixed in. The singer writes his own lyrics so every word sits naturally on the melody: short punchy lines, chantable, lots of repetition. The hook is a huge gang chant of the hero's name, 'Rudra', that the whole crowd shouts back, simple enough to sing on first listen. Story: Rudra, a street-smart Chennai boy everyone underestimated, walks back into his area and the whole street goes wild. Lead vocal: a young, raw, energetic male voice with attitude and a slightly nasal street edge, powerful and confident, half sung half shouted, with a short fast Tamil rap line. Big gang vocals, crowd 'hey' shouts and whistles. 128 BPM. Starts with a tense whispered build and ticking percussion, the name chant within the first 12 seconds, a riser, then a massive drop around 20 seconds where the kuthu drums and 808 hit together, a second even bigger hook with the crowd at full power, ends on one last shouted 'Rudra' and a hard stop.
